card: Removes redundant assertions checking WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS across descriptor-specific CWallet methods and hoists the descriptor check from UpgradeDescriptorCache() into its callers. Because legacy wallets can no longer be loaded for standard operation, the author notes that these assertions clutter the codebase without providing safety value. Moving the check to callers such as CWallet::Unlock also clarifies which code paths may still encounter legacy wallets during wallet migration. This is an internal code cleanup with no user-facing changes.
changed_since_previous: Rebased with no substantive changes to the underlying approach or affected functions.
evidence: Author states that legacy wallets cannot be loaded directly anymore, making assertions redundant in descriptor-specific methods and adding cognitive clutter (PR description).

Author notes that CWallet::Unlock and WalletBatch::LoadWallet are called on legacy wallets during migration (demonstrated in test_encrypted of the wallet_migration suite), so checking the flag at the call sites clarifies that descriptor wallets are not the only callers (commit ba4ae462ed).
problem: Because legacy wallets can no longer be loaded for normal operations, asserting the descriptor wallet flag across descriptor-specific methods is obsolete and creates cognitive overhead for developers. In addition, checking the flag inside UpgradeDescriptorCache() obscured the fact that its callers can still encounter legacy wallets in migration workflows.

risk.why: Mistakes could theoretically allow non-descriptor wallet paths to invoke descriptor logic without failing early, but legacy wallets are already blocked from loading outside migration workflows.

summary: Removes redundant assertions verifying WALLET_FLAG_DESCRIPTORS across descriptor-specific CWallet methods (EncryptWallet, LoadActiveScriptPubKeyMan, AddWalletDescriptor, GetHDPubKeys, and GetKey). It also relocates the descriptor flag check out of UpgradeDescriptorCache() directly into its callers, CWallet::Unlock and WalletBatch::LoadWallet.
